transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
A widow sues OpenAI and Luka over ChatGPT use allegedly contributing to her husband's suicide, still open per Courthouse News.
Google's Gemini 4 Carbon scores 59, top in artificial intelligence analysis index, reported by The Yeshiva World.
Google announces Gemini 4 Carbon, top-ranked on artificial intelligence index, with pricing and cybersecurity claims, but no model ID or technical specs, reported by OrcaRouter.
Google's Gemini 4 Carbon and Argon differ in intelligence and access, with no model named Pro, reported by OrcaRouter.
SentinelOne adds Anthropic's Claude Mythos 5.1 to its artificial intelligence security service amid rising artificial intelligence-driven vulnerability threats, reported by SMBtech.
